purpose: Fictional demo interiors and SheNest brand assets. Not photographs of actual listed properties.

assets.prompt: Use case: logo-brand. Asset type: new logo icon for SheNest, a women-focused home and roommate platform. Create one original, beautifully simple flat logo icon: a dusty rose (#d98a9e) circular badge containing a clean white house roof and a gently curved S-shaped nesting ribbon, suggesting home, belonging and shelter. Compact bold silhouette readable at 35px or favicon size. Balanced negative space, centered on a square canvas with minimal padding. Only dusty rose and white. Transparent background outside the badge, true alpha transparency. No wordmark, no other text, no mockup, no gradient, no shadows, no watermark.

Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: SheNest homepage hero image. A welcoming contemporary Lagos apartment living room: cream sofa, subtle blush cushions, warm wooden coffee table, a leafy indoor plant, linen curtains and broad daylight windows. Quiet, secure-feeling, lived-in but tidy accommodation for young professionals. Photorealistic interior editorial photography, natural material texture, realistic room geometry, warm balanced daylight, not an extravagant mansion or CGI render. Landscape 3:2 composition with central furniture safely framed for square and mobile crops. No people, text, branding, collage or watermark.
